reason: Revised spec E-20260926-03-r2 adds a raw per-source threshold arm (A3), cross-fits over whole sessions or documents, makes held-out Brier and log loss the calibration endpoint, and reports selection precision only as a rank-invariance check, so no gain is attributed to recalibration that per-source thresholding explains; it rests on N-20260926-07 alone. It can move B14 (working) only by what the data show, before H5 and H10b set probability thresholds and bands; completing the packet is a prerequisite and it stays queued while policy is unset.
